subject: Money
title: Bitcoin Regulation
description: Learn Bitcoin Regulation in one minute.

hook.text: El Salvador made Bitcoin legal tender in 2021. China banned all crypto trading the same year. Opposite extremes.

buildup.text: Governments respond to Bitcoin differently. Some embrace it for innovation. Others fear losing monetary control.

discovery.text: The U.S. approved Bitcoin ETFs in January 2024. Wall Street can now sell Bitcoin exposure to retirement accounts.

twist.text: Regulation legitimizes crypto but contradicts its founding ethos. Bitcoin was built to escape government control.

climax.text: Full regulation makes crypto safer but less revolutionary. The tension between legitimacy and decentralization endures.

punchline.text: Built to avoid governments. Now asking for their approval.

quiz.question: What happened in January 2024 regarding Bitcoin in the U.S.?
